explication: Apify MCP Server exposes Apify Actors and platform operations to AI assistants through MCP. A client connects over Streamable HTTP or local stdio, discovers tools/resources/prompts, invokes a selected operation, and receives results from Apify. The graph separates tool discovery and execution from Actor search/run workflows, platform-management tools, and resource/widget surfaces; payment providers are an optional execution capability. README documents the product-level workflows; source-index references and sampled excerpts support selected internal links, but unsampled implementations are not claimed as inspected.
